Global.name: COMBO_MAX_COUNT
Global.Comment: Maximum values of combo box input object

Global.name: GET_RESERVED_ENTITIES_LIMIT
Global.Comment: The max number of retrieved entities from TDM_RESERVED_ENTITIES, if set to zero then no limit

Global.name: MASKING_CACHE_TTL
Global.Comment: The TTL for masking cache

Global.name: MAX_NUMBER_OF_ENTITIES_IN_LIST
Global.Comment: The maximum number of entities to be returned to be displayed in list of entities

Global.name: SEQ_CACHE_INTERFACE
Global.Comment: The interface to be used for storing the cache of Masking

Global.name: TDM_DATAFLUX_TASK
Global.Comment: Indicator to mark the task as dataflux or not

Global.name: TDM_DELETE_BEFORE_LOAD
Global.Comment: Indicator to delete the instance to target DB

Global.name: TDM_INSERT_TO_TARGET
Global.Comment: Indicator to insert the instance to target DB

Global.name: TDM_LU_RETENTION_PERIOD_TYPE
Global.Comment: Each Instance can have a TTL, this global holds the type of the TTL and it can have one of the following values:Minutes, Hours, Days, Weeks, or Years

Global.name: TDM_LU_RETENTION_PERIOD_VALUE
Global.Comment: The value of the TTL based on the type defined in TDM_LU_RETENTION_PERIOD_TYPE. Populate this global with zero or empty value to avoid setting a TTL on the TDM LUIs.

Global.name: TDM_PARAMETERS_SEPARATOR
Global.Comment: The separator to be used for parsing the values of Parameters

Global.name: TDM_POPULATE_JMX_STATS
Global.Comment: Indicates whether to run add TDM statitics

Global.name: TDM_SOURCE_PRODUCT_VERSION
Global.Comment: Source product version to override by task execution process

Global.name: TDM_TARGET_PRODUCT_VERSION
Global.Comment: Target product version to override by task execution process

Global.name: TDM_DEBUG_MODE
Global.Comment: This flag is used to enble running sync in Studio

Global.name: ROOT_COLUMN_NAME
Global.Comment: The column name of the entity id. The name and the order of the root column name must be aligned with root_table_name. For example- if you populate two tables in root_Table_name (separated by a comma), you must populate also two values in this global where the first column referes to the first table name the second column refers to the second table name

Global.name: ROOT_TABLE_NAME
Global.Comment: The name of the main source LU table or tables. You can populate several tables separated by a comma.

Global.name: D2D_CONF_SEPERATOR
Global.Comment: D2DConfiguration (MTable) column Delimitter.

Global.name: D2D_EXEC_ID
Global.Comment: Track the execution Id, Inside a Get Session, No default value

Global.name: D2D_EXEC_MODE
Global.Comment: D2D Execution Mode: D2D (D2D LU Based), Direct (TDM LU Based, using TAR keys to select data in DBs), Extract (TDM LU Based, loading LUI from source and target into Fabric), F2F (Using Remote and/or Local Fabric Connections to compare LUI to LUI)

Global.name: D2D_F2F_SCHEMA_SRC
Global.Comment: SRC LU Name or Schema Name for F2F Mode: if value is 'Interface' or empty - D2D will try to get it from Interface as defined in D2D_FABRIC_INTERFACE_SRC, otherwise use it from global

Global.name: D2D_F2F_SCHEMA_TAR
Global.Comment: TAR LU Name or Schema Name for F2F Mode: if value is 'Interface' or empty - D2D will try to get it from Interface as defined in D2D_FABRIC_INTERFACE_TAR, otherwise use it from global

Global.name: D2D_FABRIC_INTERFACE_SRC
Global.Comment: Fabric remote interface name for Source Fabric Clsuter (for fabric to fabric mode)

Global.name: D2D_FABRIC_INTERFACE_TAR
Global.Comment: Fabric remote interface name for Target Fabric Clsuter (for fabric to fabric mode)

Global.name: D2D_INSTANCE_TTL
Global.Comment: D2D Instance TTL

Global.name: D2D_LOAD_SCHEMA
Global.Comment: Name of the schema where the result tables are stored. When stored in fabric Common tables, use the schema name specified in the Common table properties

Global.name: D2D_REPORT_MAX_SIZE
Global.Comment: Report max size - defines the max size of the report, higher than this threshold process will register only mismatches

Global.name: D2D_RESULT_INTERFACE
Global.Comment: Location where to store the D2D result tables. To store in Fabric's Common table, use fabric

Global.name: D2D_SOURCE_ENV
Global.Comment: SOURCE Tables ENVIRONMENT

Global.name: D2D_SYNC_MODE
Global.Comment: D2D sync mode, FORCE, OFF or ON

Global.name: D2D_TABLE_DISCOVERY_STRATEGY
Global.Comment: Table Discovery Strategy ('MTable' - work only with Mtable values; 'Full' - discovers tables from the remote interface)

Global.name: D2D_TARGET_ENV
Global.Comment: DESTINATION Tables ENVIRONMENT
